Those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and do righteousness, whether believers, Jews, Christians or Sabeans, have their reward with their Lord without fear or grief.
Some people sell themselves seeking the approval of Allah, and Allah is kind to His servants.
Those who believe, do righteous deeds, establish prayer and give zakah have their reward with their Lord, without fear or grief.
The Messenger and the believers believe in Allah, His angels, books and messengers without distinction, and say they hear and obey and seek His forgiveness.
They are the patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend in Allah's way and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
Believers are the best nation produced for mankind, enjoining right, forbidding wrong and believing in Allah; it would have been better had the People of the Scripture believed.
Whoever reverts from his religion, Allah will bring a people He loves and who love Him, humble to believers, powerful against disbelievers, striving and fearless of blame.
Believers, Jews, Sabeans and Christians who believe in Allah and the Last Day and do righteousness will have no fear and will not grieve.
The Prophet is told to warn with the Quran those who fear the gathering, not to send away those who call on their Lord, and to greet believers with peace.
True believers fear when Allah is mentioned, grow in faith when His verses are recited, rely on Him, pray and spend; they have ranks, forgiveness and noble provision.
Giving pilgrims water and maintaining al-Masjid al-Haram do not equal believing and striving; those who believed, emigrated and strove with wealth and lives are greater, promised mercy and gardens.
Believing men and women are allies of one another, enjoining right, praying, giving zakah and obeying; Allah promises them gardens and His approval, which is greater.
The Messenger and those who believed with him fought with their wealth and lives; for them are good things, success and gardens beneath which rivers flow.
Allah is pleased with the first forerunners among the Muhajireen and the Ansar and those who followed them in good conduct, and has prepared gardens for them.
Allah has bought the believers' lives and wealth for Paradise as they fight in His cause, promised in the Torah, Gospel and Quran; they repent, worship and keep His limits.
The allies of Allah, who believed and feared Him, have no fear and will not grieve, and have good tidings in this life and the Hereafter.
The Most Merciful will appoint affection for those who believe and do righteous deeds.
Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, for Allah does what He intends.
Allah defends those who believe and does not like anyone treacherous and ungrateful.
The successful believers are humble in prayer, avoid ill speech, give zakah, guard their private parts, keep trusts and promises, and maintain their prayers; they will inherit al-Firdaus forever.
Those who fear their Lord, believe in His signs, associate none with Him and give with fearful hearts, knowing they will return to Him, hasten to good deeds.
Allah promises believers who do righteous deeds succession on earth, an established religion and security after fear, and tells them to pray, give zakah and obey the Messenger.
The servants of the Most Merciful walk easily, pray at night, spend moderately, invoke no other deity, avoid unlawful killing and intercourse, repent, shun falsehood, and are given the Chamber.
Believers in Allah's verses prostrate when reminded, shun arrogance, rise from bed to call on their Lord in fear and hope, spend, and have hidden comfort as reward.
Seeing the companies, believers said Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth and grew in faith; some have fulfilled their vow and others await, and Allah rewards the truthful.
Allah has prepared forgiveness and great reward for Muslim and believing men and women who are obedient, truthful, patient, humble, charitable, fasting, chaste and remember Allah often.
Those who recite Allah's Book, pray and spend secretly and openly expect a profit that will never perish, and He will give them their rewards in full and more.
Those who avoid worshipping Taghut and turn to Allah, listening to speech and following its best, receive good tidings; Allah has guided them, and they have understanding.
Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have an uninterrupted reward.
Angels descend on those who say 'Our Lord is Allah' and stay on a right course, telling them not to fear or grieve and giving them good tidings of Paradise.
Wrongdoers will fear what they earned, while believers who do righteous deeds will have whatever they wish in gardens; the Prophet asks no payment, only good will through kinship.
Worldly things are passing enjoyment; what is with Allah is better for believers who rely on Him, avoid major sins, forgive, pray, consult, spend and defend themselves against tyranny.
Those who say 'Our Lord is Allah' and stay on a right course will have no fear or grief, abiding in Paradise as a reward.
Allah sent tranquillity into the believers' hearts at Hudaybiyyah to increase their faith, and will admit believing men and women to eternal gardens and remove their misdeeds.
Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and those with him are forceful against disbelievers, merciful among themselves, marked by prostration, and described in the Torah and Gospel.
Believers are asked whether their hearts should not humble at Allah's remembrance, unlike earlier Scripture holders whose hearts hardened; Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness.
Believers are offered a saving transaction: believe and strive with wealth and lives, gaining forgiveness, gardens, lasting dwellings, victory from Allah and an imminent conquest.
Man is anxious and withholding, except those constant in prayer, giving the needy their right, believing in the Recompense, guarding their private parts and true to trusts and testimony.
By time, mankind is in loss, except those who believe, do righteous deeds and urge one another to truth and patience.
